boards.title: Your First Weekend at East Carolina University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence of named campus and Greenville stops for getting oriented, meeting people, and choosing a weekend activity.

cards.title: Begin at the Main Campus Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · orientation and campus services
cards.notes: Use the first-floor public areas as a meeting point, then check posted student programming or ask the desk where the day’s activities are happening.
cards.short_summary: A central starting point with inclusive student spaces and dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU describes the Main Campus Student Center as offering inclusive, engaging spaces for student life and well-being, with multiple dining options.
cards.source_title: Main Campus Student Center | Student Centers | ECU
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Centers hours page before visiting; building access and programming vary by date.

cards.title: Take a first campus photo at the ECU Letters
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · outside the Main Campus Student Center
cards.notes: Walk outside the Main Campus Student Center for a quick group-photo stop, then use the campus map to choose the next nearby destination.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark beside the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU identifies the bold ECU letters outside the Main Campus Student Center as a campus landmark and photo spot.
cards.source_title: Iconic Pirate History | Student Academic Success Services | ECU
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; use the ECU campus map for current wayfinding.

cards.title: Cross Campus Mall and get your bearings
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Main Campus pedestrian route
cards.notes: Make this your walking connector: pause to orient yourself on the interactive map, identify classrooms, and pick a route toward Joyner Library.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed Main Campus landmark that works as a natural walking pause.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU’s interactive campus map lists Campus Mall as a named Main Campus location.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor route; consult the interactive map for accessibility and construction updates.

cards.title: Make Joyner Library your weekend reset point
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Main Campus Library
cards.notes: Stop by the circulation or research desk to learn the building layout, then choose a quiet place to plan the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: ECU’s main-campus library offers research help and a staffed service desk.
cards.evidence_claim: Joyner Library provides Ask a Librarian and subject-specialist liaison services; ECU publishes current Main Campus Library hours online.
cards.access_notes: Current building hours are posted by ECU and change by term; verify them before going.

cards.title: Plan a meal at West End Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · West Campus dining stop
cards.notes: Review the dining page and your meal-plan options before heading over, then use dinner as an easy way to reconnect with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: A named ECU dining hall used in new-student programming.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU’s 2026 orientation schedule places student dinner at West End Dining Hall, and ECU Dining maintains a dedicated West End location page.
cards.source_title: West End Dining Hall - ECU Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Menus and hours are published by ECU Dining; check the location page on the day because schedules can change.

cards.title: Walk by Trustees Fountain after dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Wright Circle
cards.notes: Use the fountain as a brief outdoor pause on your way across campus; read the nearby trustee inscriptions and continue toward Wright Auditorium.
cards.short_summary: A named Wright Circle landmark with documented ECU history.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU reports that Trustees Fountain in Wright Circle was dedicated in 2009, replacing the earlier Wright Fountain at the site.
cards.source_title: Trustees Fountain dedicated | ECU News Services
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark near Wright Auditorium; observe from public walkways.

cards.title: Check Wright Auditorium’s current calendar
cards.subtitle: Friday night · 212 Wright Circle
cards.notes: Look for a performance that fits your weekend and confirm ticket or entry details before you go; the venue’s events include music, theatre, and dance.
cards.short_summary: A historic multi-use campus venue with an active event calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU says Wright Auditorium hosts symphonies, plays, concerts, and dance performances throughout the year.
cards.access_notes: Events and admission requirements vary; ECU lists the venue at 212 Wright Circle and directs visitors to event-specific information.

cards.entity_name: Richard R. and JoAnn M. Eakin Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Try one activity at Eakin Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Campus Recreation & Wellness
cards.notes: Bring the required ECU credentials and choose one approachable activity, such as a basketball court, indoor track, pool, or climbing wall session.
cards.short_summary: A large ECU recreation facility with varied indoor activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU states that the Eakin Student Recreation Center has basketball courts, a climbing wall, indoor and outdoor pools, fitness areas, and an indoor track.
cards.source_title: Richard R. and JoAnn M. Eakin Student Recreation Center | Campus Recreation & Wellness | ECU
cards.access_notes: Facility use may require student eligibility and hours vary; verify Campus Recreation & Wellness access rules before arrival.

cards.title: Make an outdoor plan at North Recreational Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · about 10 minutes from Main Campus by car
cards.notes: Coordinate transportation before leaving campus, then choose a daytime activity around the multipurpose fields, water, or sand beach within posted rules.
cards.short_summary: An ECU recreation area with fields, water, and a sand beach.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU says the North Recreational Complex has eight multipurpose fields, six acres of water for boating and fishing, a sand beach, and is about a 10-minute drive from Main Campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Recreation & Wellness | Undergraduate Admissions | ECU
cards.access_notes: Arrange transportation and confirm current facility access, equipment, and water-activity rules with Campus Recreation & Wellness.

cards.title: Close the weekend at Greenville Town Common
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime · 105 East First Street, Uptown Greenville
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk on the paved connections by the Tar River, visit the Sycamore Hill Gateway Plaza, and check the city calendar for all-ages programs.
cards.short_summary: Greenville’s central park connects to the Tar River Greenway and Uptown.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Greenville identifies Town Common as its central park, with 21 acres, Tar River Greenway connections, a river walk, and Sycamore Hill Gateway Plaza.
cards.source_title: Greenville Town Common | City of Greenville, NC
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public park; use daylight judgment and consult the city page for programmed events or recreation updates.
